title: Digital Systems Laboratory 1
objectives:
The objective of this lab is to allow students to devise simple logic circuits, hence giving
them an opportunity to reinforce the theoretical concepts taught in the course “Logic
Circuits”.
syllabus:
The experiments cover relevant topics prescribed in the syllabus.
Evaluation:
textbooks:
1. Morris Mano, Michael Ciletti, Digital Design. 4th ed. Prentice Hall, 2006.
2. Victor Nelson, Troy Nagle, Bill Carroll, David Irwin, Digital Logic Circuit Analysis and
Design. 1st ed. Prentice Hall, 1995.
3. A. P. Godse, Digital Logic Circuits. 2nd ed. Technical Publications, 2011.
